title.zh: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
title.en: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】

current_state.zh: Binance said its investigation into the security breach uncovered additional intrusion points beyond a compromised laptop, that roughly $3 billion in affected assets has been frozen with partners, that all losses will be covered by the SAFU fund and corporate capital, and that withdrawals should resume in about 45 hours while deposits remain unaffected.
